description: Save the current lot's description/blurb string. Wire mechanism is a DataService field sync on the Lot struct — no dedicated VMNet command. Typically triggered when the owner closes the lot-page edit panel or presses Save. Persists server-side via the city DataService; propagates to `Lot_Description` readers on the next struct refresh.
